label: Bible Study
prompt: The wilderness and the solitary place shall be glad for them; and the desert shall rejoice, and blossom as the _____.
verse: The wilderness and the solitary place shall be glad for them; and the desert shall rejoice, and blossom as the rose.
note: Desert flowers in prophecy — the wilderness breaking into bloom when God redeems.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And Judah and Israel dwelt safely, every man under his vine and under his _____ tree, from Dan even to Beer-sheba, all the days of Solomon.
verse: And Judah and Israel dwelt safely, every man under his vine and under his fig tree, from Dan even to Beer-sheba, all the days of Solomon.
note: Solomon's golden age: everyone safe under his own vine and fig tree, from Dan to Beer-sheba.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Came behind him, and touched the _____ of his garment: and immediately her issue of blood stanched.
verse: Came behind him, and touched the border of his garment: and immediately her issue of blood stanched.
note: She only touched the border of his garment in a crowd — and Jesus still stopped to ask who touched him.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And Naboth said to Ahab, The LORD forbid it me, that I should give the _____ of my fathers unto thee.
verse: And Naboth said to Ahab, The LORD forbid it me, that I should give the inheritance of my fathers unto thee.
note: Naboth wouldn't sell his family vineyard to King Ahab — the Law forbade it, and Jezebel had him framed.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And they journeyed from mount Hor by the way of the Red sea, to compass the land of Edom: and the soul of the people was much _____ because of the way.
verse: And they journeyed from mount Hor by the way of the Red sea, to compass the land of Edom: and the soul of the people was much discouraged because of the way.
note: The long detour around Edom wore Israel down — 'much discouraged because of the way' — and the fiery serpents followed.
